name: Escape From Horny Planet
source: “Escape From Horny Planet” is an adult adventure visual novel focused on feminization, femboys, furry, humiliation, corruption, and monsters. Playing as Ariandel McLovin, a lieutenant of the Space Empire whose ship was destroyed in orbit of a former imperial outpost, you must find your wife and a way to escape this forgotten world. Make the right choices to avoid falling into the lustful clutches of its inhabitants, because if you don’t, you’ll end up being someone’s wife yourself.
translation: 《逃离欲火星球》是一部主打女性化、伪娘、兽人、羞辱、恶堕与魔物要素的成人冒险视觉小说。你将扮演太空帝国中尉阿里安德尔·麦克洛文——在座舰于一处前帝国哨站轨道上被击毁后，你必须在这颗被遗忘的星球上找回妻子，并寻得逃出生天的出路。请务必做出正确的抉择，以免落入当地居民充满情欲的魔爪；否则到头来，你自己就要沦为别人的娇妻了。
